prose: SoftBank is looking to issue $10 billion and €1 billion in debt to fund its OpenAI investment, Bloomberg reports, in what would be one of the biggest junk bond sales ever. The package seeks the equivalent of more than $11 billion.
highlights: SoftBank seeks to issue $10B plus €1B in debt for its OpenAI investment.
The sale would rank among the biggest junk bond deals ever.
Total sought: the equivalent of more than $11B.
